memberdef.name: expectation

detaileddescription.para: returns the expectation $ E(x_{t_0 + \Delta t} | x_{t_0} = x_0) $ of the process after a time interval $ \Delta t $ according to the given discretization. This method can be overridden in derived classes which want to hard-code a particular discretization.

memberdef.argsstring: (Time t0, Real x0, Time dt) const
memberdef.name: stdDeviation

detaileddescription.para: returns the standard deviation $ S(x_{t_0 + \Delta t} | x_{t_0} = x_0) $ of the process after a time interval $ \Delta t $ according to the given discretization. This method can be overridden in derived classes which want to hard-code a particular discretization.

memberdef.name: variance

detaileddescription.para: returns the variance $ V(x_{t_0 + \Delta t} | x_{t_0} = x_0) $ of the process after a time interval $ \Delta t $ according to the given discretization. This method can be overridden in derived classes which want to hard-code a particular discretization.

memberdef.argsstring: (Time t0, Real x0, Time dt, Real dw) const
memberdef.name: evolve

detaileddescription.para: returns the asset value after a time interval $ \Delta t $ according to the given discretization. By default, it returns \[ E(x_0,t_0,\Delta t) + S(x_0,t_0,\Delta t) \cdot \Delta w \] where $ E $ is the expectation and $ S $ the standard deviation.
applies a change to the asset value. By default, it returns $ x + \Delta x $.

detaileddescription.para: returns the asset value after a time interval $ \Delta t $ according to the given discretization. By default, it returns \[ E(\mathrm{x}_0,t_0,\Delta t) + S(\mathrm{x}_0,t_0,\Delta t) \cdot \Delta \mathrm{w} \] where $ E $ is the expectation and $ S $ the standard deviation.
applies a change to the asset value. By default, it returns $ \mathrm{x} + \Delta \mathrm{x} $.
This class describes a stochastic process governed by \[ dx_t = \mu(t, x_t)dt + \sigma(t, x_t)dW_t. \]
